bullets: On Tuesday 13 October, DLD recorded 523 sales worth AED 1.4bn, which is 12.5% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 70.9% of the total volume, compared to 61.2% over the last 7 days.

JVC led 7-day sales with 192 transactions, followed by Dubai South with 191 and Downtown Jebel Ali with 151.
